description: YouTube API: List playlist videos. The videos of a public playlist in playlist order, page by page: follow `pagination.next_cursor`; every page costs the same, the last one like the first. `meta.total_videos` and `meta.total_pages` give the size of the playlist (null when YouTube does not show it). Private and Mix playlists answer 404. Price: 1 credit per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

playlist_id.description: Playlist ID: the `list=` value of a playlist URL (`PL...`, `UU...`, `OLAK5uy_...`)

name: youtube_playlist_videos
title: List playlist videos
